en: Why don't you have shoes on? It's cold outside!
I'll give you a bun, but only one.
Where's my phone? I can't see it.
note: ho = him / it (object form of on)

sentence: Dědeček má hlad, tak **mu** dám polévku.
en: Grandpa's hungry, so I'll give him soup.

sentence: Kočka **ví**, kde je myš. Pes to neví.
en: The cat knows where the mouse is. The dog doesn't.
Do you know where the beer is around here?
Nobody's here. I'm here alone.
That's our house and our garden.

sentence: Děti **jdou** do školy a pes jde spát.
en: The kids go to school and the dog goes to sleep.
Where are you going so fast?

sentence: Honza celý den **nedělá** nic. Jenom leží.
en: Honza does nothing all day. He just lies around.

sentence: **Dej** mi to, prosím. **Dám** ti to zítra zpátky.
en: Give it to me, please. I'll give it back to you tomorrow.

sentence: Je to **tvoje** kočka? Sedí na stole a jí **tvoji** polévku!
en: Is that your cat? It's sitting on the table eating your soup!
Do you see that? There's a fox sitting in the tree!

sentence: Tady je kuchyně a **tam** je můj pokoj.
en: Here's the kitchen and there's my room.
Cats like fish.
note: mít rád = to like · rády = for feminine plural

en: There's a lot of sun in Australia.

sentence: Chceš **víc** kaše? – Ne, děkuju, už nemůžu.
en: Do you want more porridge? – No thanks, I can't any more.
Someone's at the door! – Don't open it!
It's late. I don't think he's coming now.
note: přijde = (he) will come · nepřijde = won't come

en: The dog finds every bone in the garden.
The cat grabs the fish and runs off.
Look at that! The dog is dancing!

sentence: **Kdybys** měl hlad, v kuchyni je polévka.
en: If you get hungry, there's soup in the kitchen.
I slept the whole night like a log.
I don't want to go alone. Come with me!
Come here! Not there – here!
note: sem = (to) here, direction · tady = here, place

sentence: Psst! **Slyšíš** to? Někdo je v kuchyni.
en: Shh! Do you hear that? Someone's in the kitchen.
This really is good beer.
Don't tell anyone! Nobody can know.
I only speak a little Czech.
I've only got five minutes.
Coffee without milk, please.
That's enough! I'm going to bed.
I've been waiting for the bus for an hour.
Don't be scared, that dog is friendly.
note: neboj se = don't be afraid (bát se)

en: In the morning I listen to a Czech podcast.
In the evening I play games on the computer.
Where did you put my shoes?!
One cat is sleeping, the other is eating.
I always have time for coffee.
I've got a headache.
note: hlava = head (bolí mě hlava = my head hurts)

en: My money's gone!
Work again. Oh well.

sentence: Proč ten pes **běží** tak rychle? – Vidí kočku.
en: Why is that dog running so fast? – It's seen a cat.
Do you understand me when I talk fast?
We always eat together, morning and evening.
Work first, then beer.
I don't have time today, but tomorrow, yes.
The dog is standing by the door. It wants to go out.
Knock knock! – Come in!
note: pojďte dál = come in · dál = further, on

sentence: Domácí polévka je **lepší** než v restauraci.
en: Homemade soup is better than in a restaurant.
A fox runs across the road.
